verses.text: Since you were raised with Christ, focus on the things above, where Christ is seated at God's right hand.
Set your minds on what is above, not on earthly things.
You died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, who is your life, appears, you'll also appear with him in glory.
So put to death whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, uncontrolled passion, evil desire, and greed, which is idolatry.
Because of these things, God's anger is coming on those who disobey.
You used to live that way too, when you were part of that life.
But now get rid of all of it: anger, rage, malice, slander, and obscene talk.
Don't lie to one another. You've taken off the old self and its practices,
and put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge to become like its Creator.
In this new life there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, foreigner, Scythian, enslaved or free. Christ is everything and is in everyone.
So as God's chosen, holy, and dearly loved people, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Put up with one another and forgive each other whenever someone has a complaint. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
Above all, put on love, which ties everything together in perfect unity.
Let Christ's peace rule in your hearts, since you were called to peace as one body. And be thankful.
Let Christ's word live richly among you. Teach and guide one another with all wisdom, through psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing to God with gratitude in your hearts.
Whatever you do, in word or action, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting for those who belong to the Lord.
Husbands, love your wives, and don't treat them harshly.
Children, obey your parents in everything, because this pleases the Lord.
Fathers, don't discourage your children, or they'll lose heart.
Enslaved people, obey your earthly masters in everything. Don't work only when they're watching, just to please them; work sincerely, out of reverence for the Lord.
Whatever you do, work at it wholeheartedly, as if you were working for the Lord, not for people.
You know that the Lord will reward you with the inheritance. You serve the Lord Christ.
Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for the wrong they did, and God shows no favoritism.
